parameters.purpose: Balance false positives and negatives in original overall/male sample; positive screen requires further assessment
parameters.population: 396 US veterans seeking VA primary care; mean age 61.4 (SD15.5), range21–93;333 men (84.1%); not Chinese or school population
parameters.female_caution: At cutpoint4 female sensitivity0.67 and 6 of18 CAPS-5-positive women missed; lower cutpoint may be considered by clinicians depending on setting/resources. Do not auto-assign cutoff by user sex.
parameters.citation: Bovin MJ, Kimerling R, Weathers FW, et al. (2021). Diagnostic Accuracy and Acceptability of the PC-PTSD-5 Among US Veterans. JAMA Network Open,4(2),e2036733.
parameters.limitations: Clinical screening, not diagnosis. Performance changes by population and purpose; no norm/threshold validated for this Chinese working translation. No automatic active cut-point.

scoring.total: If gate NO then 0 and stop; if gate YES then sum of YES in symptom items 1–5
scoring.direction: Higher = more endorsed past-month experiences; not diagnosis
scoring.routing_implementation_gate: Do not instantiate executable instrument unless exposure gate is required, NO branch stops with 0, YES branch requires all 5 items, and missing gate cannot score. The 5 symptoms cannot be substituted as standalone form or ordinary six-item summed scale.
